Hi Lena,

Following up on INV-2026-887 (due 2027-05-18). Our billing shows the invoice still outstanding — attaching a fresh copy for your AP team. If the card on file was intended, we can attempt one more authorization; otherwise we can accept a one-time ACH/wire or a split payment (50% today / 50% within 30 days).

Quick options:
- Retry card: we can schedule a retry for 05/21 (no extra fee).
- Wire: provide beneficiary details and we’ll mark escrow-release on receipt.
- Split payment: we’ll issue a revised invoice with two line items and update accounting.

Also, I see you requested VAT reclaim documentation last month — if you can share your VAT certificate, we’ll attach the proof on our side so tax is handled correctly.

Attachments: INV-2026-887.pdf

Can you confirm which route you prefer? If it helps, I’m happy to hop on a 15-min call with your AP team to unblock.
